entries.label: SaintLogic — salle de Chaigidiel
entries.scene: The actual Chaigidiel boss industrial storage room in Metal Gear AC!D2. Recreate the distinctive large burgundy-red cylindrical tanks inside thin yellow square cage frames, tall ochre-yellow rectangular cargo stacks between them, green-grey grated steel floor and straight dark inset maintenance strips, yellow-black safety markings around a rectangular recessed metal panel. Rear perimeter plain dark green industrial walls and pale cyan-green light bands. Tanks and cargo are behind the empty foreground combat lane. Preserve the vivid cel-shaded red/yellow/teal PSP aesthetic. No people, no glowing gameplay movement grid, no card graphics or red motion icons.
